# CANDIDATE: VWAP_RIBBON_FADE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When price extends >0.75*ATR above VWAP while the EMA ribbon is bearish, a mean-reversion long is favored as short covering pressure builds. This edge exists because extreme VWAP deviations during bearish ribbon conditions often trigger short-covering rallies as trapped shorts exit, creating a temporary imbalance favoring longs.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Enter long at the close of a bar when:  
- close < VWAP  
- prior_close > VWAP + 0.75*ATR(14)  
- EMA9 < EMA21 < EMA55 (ribbon bearish)  

**Exit:**  
- Initial stop: chart-stop at the most recent swing low (structure invalidation)  
- TP1: exit 1/3 position at 1.5R (risk-reward)  
- Runner: trail remaining 2/3 position at 15% off high-water mark  
- Time exit: 15:50 ET hard stop  

**Regime filters:**  
- Only active between 09:45-11:30 EST  
- VIX < 18 (low-volatility regime)  
- Avoid FOMC windows (30 min before/after announcements)
